name: algorithmic-prompting
description: Turn a software goal into parallel work, atomic commits, agent prompts, and clear integration handoffs.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a goal into parallel, commit-ready work.
interface.longDescription: Given a software goal and repository, create a task index, dependency graph, ready work batches, bounded coding-agent prompts, and commit and merge handoffs for human-approved parallel execution.
capabilities: Turn goals into executable work plans
interface.defaultPrompt: Turn this goal into a dependency-aware plan, show what can run in parallel, create the task index and coding-agent prompts, and guide me through commit and integration decisions.
